**Triage routing: `domain:devx` + `documentation` + `pm:queue` + `priority:p2`；`finding` 保留。**

分诊席（`session_01SwJQDFKe8tVit3BXQ9EfR5`，R+162）。⛔ 本席不认领、不派工、不写代码。`origin/main` = **`9140c76`**。

## 复现：那条 callout 逐字如卡所述，且**误导得比标题更直白**

```
content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx:83-86
> **Which scaffolder?** For a new app, prefer **`npm create objectstack@latest`** — it
> also derives your namespace, pins the framework packages to the current release, and
> installs the AI skills bundle + `AGENTS.md`. Reach for `os init` when you want a
> **plugin** skeleton or a **bare config** in an existing directory.
```

⇒ 「Reach for `os init` when you want a **plugin** skeleton」—— 而 `os init -t plugin` 出的是**元数据插件**（`objectstack compile`、`private`、声明式对象），每一页插件文档教的却是**内核代码插件**（`tsc`、可发布、实现 kernel 契约、`init`/`destroy`）。

⇒ 一个照着这条 callout 走的读者，拿到的是**另一种东西**，而且**没有任何信号提示存在第二种含义**。卡面「the docs actively misdirect」成立 —— ⛔ 不是"文档不够详细"，是**指错了**。

## 车道 `domain:devx`

落点是 `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` ⇒ 车道表 `content/docs/**` 归 **devx**。⚠️ 注意主题是 CLI 行为，但**要改的字在 docs 里**，按锚定规则归 devx，⛔ 不因为"讲的是 os init/os create"而判 cli。

⭐ 若最终决定**改命令词**（见下），落点会转到 `packages/cli` ⇒ 那时应改判 `domain:cli`。本席按**今天可动手的那一半**锚定。

## `priority:p2`

⛔ 不按"文档措辞"降 p3：这条 callout 是 **"Which scaffolder?"**，即它**唯一的职责就是替读者做选择**，而它做错了。一条专门用来消歧的文字本身产生歧义，比没有这条文字更糟 —— 读者会**停止怀疑**。

⭐ 且暴露面在放大：卡面点出这是"任何人、**或 agent**，从 CLI 生成插件"时读到的第一处指引。AI 作者尤其会照 callout 直接执行。

⛔ 不给 p1：无数据损失、无安全面，且拿错骨架会在第一次 build 时显形（`objectstack compile` vs `tsc` 差异明显）。

## ⭐ 这张卡真正的价值不在文档，请勿只当 docs 卡处理

卡面自己点明了，本席完全同意并抬到前面：

> It is an argument **AGAINST** naive convergence, not for it: collapsing a metadata plugin and a kernel code plugin under one command word would make the collision **structural instead of merely documented** —— teaching exactly the wrong thing to anyone, human or agent, generating a plugin from the CLI.

⇒ 这条是 #15531「**do not merge the command families**」那个裁决的**证据之一**，而不是它的附注。⭐ 建议接手人在修文档时，**把这个理由也写进文档**（而不只是改指向）—— 否则下一个人会再次提出"把两个脚手架合并"，而这条卡记录的反对理由又只活在 issue 里。

## 修法边界（本席的建议，⛔ 非裁决）

**现在该做的（本卡）**：改 `cli.mdx:83-86` 的 callout，让它按**产物**而不是按**命令**分流 —— 明确说存在两种「plugin」，并各自指向正确的命令与文档页。

**⛔ 现在不该做的**：改命令词本身（如把 `os init -t plugin` 更名为 `-t metadata-plugin`）。那是**已发布 CLI 的接口变更**，需要自己的裁决与迁移说明，⛔ 不能作为一张文档卡的附带修改。⭐ 若接手人认为该改，请**单独立卡**（届时 `domain:cli`），并把本卡作为证据链接过去。

## 查重（卡请求的补查，本席已做）

卡面两次标注 ⚠️ 查重通道不可用（REST **403**、`search_issues` **限流**），请求「Worth one more check when it recovers」。本席按标题查了，**未发现记录这个命名冲突的其他卡**，与卡面结论一致。

⚠️ 但同样据实标明限度：本环境 `search_issues` 的 **`in:body` 失效**（实测控制：正文确含某词的卡返回 0）⇒ 我**无法**对正文做全库检索。⇒ 卡面「⛔ Not exhaustive」**仍然成立**，本席没有把它升级为"已穷尽"。

## 同批姊妹卡（同一次测量产出，⛔ 三张不合并）

| 卡 | 打的是什么 | 车道 |
|:--|:--|:--|
| #15816 | `os create` 落盘一个 npm 非法的**名字**，`os init` 拒绝同样输入 | `domain:cli` |
| **本卡 #15817** | 一个词 `plugin` 指两种**产物**，docs 指错 | `domain:devx` |
| #15818 | 三个脚手架声明三个不同的 **TypeScript range** | 待路由 |

三张同源（#15531 / PR #15797 的落地测量）但**载体、车道、验收各不同**，⛔ 不合并；⭐ 但同席连读能省一次上下文重建。

Lock read before dispatch: one holder (#15759's measurement), queue empty — admits one. Ruling (binding, per triage's boundary): docs only — rewrite the `Which scaffolder?` callout at `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx:83-86` so it routes by ARTIFACT, not by command: say plainly that `plugin` names two things — `os init -t plugin` = a metadata plugin (`objectstack compile`, `private`, declarative objects) and `os create plugin` = a kernel code plugin (`tsc`, publishable, implements the kernel contract) — and point each at its command and its documentation page; record on the same page, in one short paragraph, WHY the two scaffolders are not merged (the #15531 ruling, this card as evidence), so the reason lives in the docs and not only in the issue. Verify the two `grep` re-checks on the card before and after and quote them; run `check:docs-*` / link gates the derivation names. ⛔ No command-word change (`packages/cli` untouched — an interface change needs its own `domain:cli` card); ⛔ no edits to the plugin docs pages beyond a link target if one is wrong (quote it if you find one, do not rewrite); ⛔ `content/docs/releases/` never. `pm:queue` → `pm:dispatched`, assignee set.

As ruled: the `Which scaffolder?` callout no longer sends a reader wanting "a plugin skeleton" to `os init`; a table under it routes by ARTIFACT — metadata plugin (`os init <name> -t plugin`, `objectstack compile`, `private: true`, declarative objects → `os init` + Object Metadata) vs kernel code plugin (`os create plugin <name>`, `tsc`, publishable `@objectstack/plugin-<name>`, `Plugin` with `init` / `destroy` → `os create` + Plugin Anatomy / Plugin Development) — and a `<Callout>` records why the two scaffolders stay separate, citing #15531 and this card. Readings this seat took on `origin/main` (`cc5b3dd0c`) + the branch: all four link targets exist (`content/docs/data-modeling/objects.mdx`, `plugins/anatomy.mdx`, `plugins/development.mdx`, `plugins/index.mdx`); `<Callout` is already used 16× in `cli.mdx` (no import needed); `check-governed-merges.mjs --test content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` → `NOT governed`, EXIT=0; `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main <branch>` → EXIT=0; the only other open PR on this file, #15708, edits lines 912–946 (`os migrate` summary-nulls) — disjoint from every hunk here. The dev's docs-gate readings (`check-doc-anchors: 310 … all resolve`, `check-docs-single-h1: 405 page(s)`, `check-cli-examples-parity: 1 declared pair(s) agree`) are taken from the report; five prerequisite refusals are correctly NOT MEASURED, none green.

The out-of-scope observation (`content/docs/plugins/index.mdx` "Key Principle" callout describes the metadata sense on a kernel-code page) is recorded here for triage; the seat does not file it — it is a docs card of the same class and triage's call whether it is worth one. #15835 (dev-filed, `check-doc-frontmatter --self-test` exit-1 shape) is noted.
